findings.message: Element "End_ok" (endEvent) has 2 incoming flows. Non-gateway elements must have at most one incoming flow.
findings.suggestion: Add an exclusive gateway before this element to join the incoming flows.

findings.message: Element "Sub_event" (subProcess) is not reachable from any start event.
findings.suggestion: Connect this element to the process flow or remove it.

findings.message: Element "Sub_event" (subProcess) has no outgoing sequence flows.
findings.suggestion: Connect this element to a downstream element or an end event.
Name start events using "Object + past participle", e.g. "Order Received", "Payment Initiated".
Name end events using "Object + state", e.g. "Order Fulfilled", "Payment Failed", "Request Rejected".

findings.message: Sub-process "On signal" has no error boundary event.
findings.suggestion: Add an error boundary event to catch unhandled errors thrown inside the sub-process.

findings.message: Error boundary on "Sub_work" leads directly to an end event — error is silently consumed.
findings.suggestion: Add error logging, compensation, or re-throw the error rather than swallowing it silently.

findings.message: Start event "Start_e" has no documentation describing expected input variables.
findings.suggestion: Add documentation listing the process input variables so callers know the expected contract.

findings.message: Variable "overdue" is referenced but never set in this process.
findings.suggestion: "overdue" is never set on any path through this process.

findings.message: Variables in scope at flow "Flow_i1": item.
Variables in scope at flow "Flow_i2": item.

fixes.description: Inserted exclusive gateway "Gateway_0000001" before "End_ok" to join 2 incoming flows
